turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call at 4:40. Why does my son have a zero in the gradebook, and why did I find out about it from him?
I didn't come here to be thanked. I asked you a question, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
A misunderstanding. I'm writing that down, Hale. A zero doesn't get entered by misunderstanding, so tell me who entered it and when.
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're steering me, Hale, and I've been doing this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, which is a matter of record and not something we need to agree on. Now answer me about the zero.
